metric_semantics.crazygames.rating: Displayed score labeled last six months; scale maximum not explicitly present in observed text. Not a usage metric.
metric_semantics.crazygames.likes: Displayed positive vote count; accumulation window unspecified. K means 1000, M means 1000000; rounding method unknown.
metric_semantics.crazygames.dislikes: Displayed negative vote count; same precision and time-window limits as likes.
metric_semantics.crazygames.plays: No game-level plays observed; null is not zero.
metric_semantics.crazygames.active_users: No game-level active users observed; never inferred from votes.

limitations: 20 selected game records and five detail-metric inspections; bounded nonrandom sample, not exhaustive.
The current homepage is labeled Top games in US today, unlike the preceding 16:00 UTC Top picks for you label; cross-run position comparisons require this scope distinction.
All metric and selection times are fresh observations from this run; unchanged displayed values do not prove zero underlying activity.
Display positions are not official numeric ranks; vote totals and ratings are not player counts or active-user counts.
Only the first five homepage detail metrics were inspected; other game-level metrics remain null, not zero.
The Hot page still has conflicting month-title and 24-hour introduction wording.
A preexisting logged-out browser session may affect recommendations. Recently played sidebar cards are excluded.
Cover files and descriptions are reused metadata with original timestamps. Exact cover URLs were re-observed but binary bytes were not re-fetched in this run.
No login, hidden API, manual gameplay or video playback used; embedded games may load automatically. An ordinary game alert was dismissed to permit navigation.
Source cover copyrights remain with their respective owners; no redistribution license asserted.
